TextList: Thank you for calling customer support. This is Rachel speaking. How can I help you today?
Hi, my wireless earbuds stopped charging after about two weeks of use.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you confirm the order number so I can look into a replacement?
Sure, it's order 9001. I'd really like a refund if possible.
I understand. I have processed a full refund and you will see it within 5 business days.
